Defense Bonus is increased to 50%
Defense Bonus is increased to 80% (Requires Ancient Twilight Level 3)

abilities.name: Spear of Glory
abilities.description: Minsitthar stabs forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing damage equal to 185% of his Attack to enemies along the way.

levelDescriptions.text: Pulls the furthest enemy towards him
Increases the damage to 210% Attack
Increases the damage to 235% Attack

abilities.name: Shield Assault
abilities.description: Minsitthar awakens the strength of the Shield and deals damage equal to 175% of his Attack to the first enemy hit, stunning the target for 2s.

levelDescriptions.text: Generates a shield equal to 120% of his Attack for himself and the ally with the lowest HP
Increase the Shield to 200% Attack
The Shield is increased to 280% Attack (Requires Ancient Twilight Level 1)

abilities.name: All United
abilities.description: When Minsitthar is on the battlefield, he will add 20 points of Energy to all allied Heroes every 3s.

levelDescriptions.text: Increase the Energy restored to 30 points
Increase the Energy restored to 40 points
Energy Regen is increased to 50 points (Requires Ancient Twilight Level 2)

abilities.name: Showtime
abilities.description: Clara restores 8% of allies' lost HP over time a total of 4 times, while dealing damage equal to 10% of enemies' Max HP to all enemies (capped at 100% of Clara's Max HP).

levelDescriptions.text: Damage is increased to 12% of the enemy's Max HP.
Damage is increased to 14% of the enemy's Max HP.
Damage is increased to 16% of the enemy's Max HP. (Requires Ancient Twilight Level 3)

abilities.name: Magic Dice
abilities.description: Clara deals damage equal to 200% of her Attack to the enemy with the highest Energy and stuns them for 0.5s. Meanwhile, Clara rolls the dice once, every 1 point rolled increasing the skill damage by 10% and extending the stun duration by 0.5s.

levelDescriptions.text: Clears the enemy's Energy if Clara rolls a 6.
Extra damage from each point is increased to 20%.
Extra damage from each point is increased to 30%.

abilities.name: Clara's Wish
abilities.description: Clara encourages the allied hero with the lowest HP percentage, granting them and herself 25 extra Lifesteal and Crit Damage for 5s. The lower the ally's HP percentage, the higher the Crit Damage Bonus (capped at 15%).

levelDescriptions.text: Crit Damage Bonus is capped at 30%.
Lifesteal is increased by 50.
Lifesteal is increased by 100. (Requires Ancient Twilight Level 1)

abilities.name: Attendant's Will
abilities.description: Allies gain Crit Rate and Damage Increase up to 3% as they lose HP. When an allied hero is dying, they will gain immunity to death for 2s. The effect can only be triggered once per hero in each battle.

levelDescriptions.text: Crit Rate and Damage Increase Bonuses are capped at 6%.
Crit Rate and Damage Increase Bonuses are capped at 9%.
Crit Rate and Damage Increase Bonuses are capped at 12%. (Requires Ancient Twilight Level 2)
